name: com.sebastianlangner.nvim-unity
description: Use Neovim (native or inside WSL) as Unity's External Script Editor. Opens files at the right line in a running Neovim via RPC (or launches one in Windows Terminal / tmux / your own terminal), keeps .sln/.csproj files up to date for Roslyn, converts paths for WSL and adds wildcard Compile items so new files get LSP support immediately.
